note: Sides are the character's own; he faces the viewer, so his left is on screen right.

groove.a.description: facing the viewer, dancing in place on bent knees with weight on his left foot, arms low and loose below the shoulders, loose relaxed hands, smiling

groove.b.description: facing the viewer, dancing in place, a small rise with both feet flat, arms low and loose below the shoulders, loose relaxed hands, smiling

groove.c.description: facing the viewer, dancing in place on bent knees with weight on his right foot, arms low and loose below the shoulders, loose relaxed hands, smiling

groove.d.description: facing the viewer, dancing in place, a small rise with both feet flat, arms low and loose below the shoulders, loose relaxed hands, smiling

pair_dance.a.description: seen in a three-quarter view from the side: the chest, hips, knees, toes and nose all point toward the lower right corner of the picture, the face in three-quarter view looking that way, smiling, absorbed in the dance, both arms held forward in a slow social-dance hold, the upper hand open at chest height and the lower hand open at waist height, both reaching toward the right side of the picture, the fingers relaxed and together, weight on the back foot, the front heel lifted

pair_dance.b.description: seen in a three-quarter view from the side: the chest, hips, knees, toes and nose all point toward the lower right corner of the picture, the face in three-quarter view looking that way, smiling, absorbed in the dance, both arms held forward in a slow social-dance hold, the upper hand open at chest height and the lower hand open at waist height, both reaching toward the right side of the picture, the fingers relaxed and together, both feet flat in a small rise

pair_dance.c.description: seen in a three-quarter view from the side: the chest, hips, knees, toes and nose all point toward the lower right corner of the picture, the face in three-quarter view looking that way, smiling, absorbed in the dance, both arms held forward in a slow social-dance hold, the upper hand open at chest height and the lower hand open at waist height, both reaching toward the right side of the picture, the fingers relaxed and together, weight on the front foot, the back heel lifted

pair_dance.d.description: seen in a three-quarter view from the side: the chest, hips, knees, toes and nose all point toward the lower right corner of the picture, the face in three-quarter view looking that way, smiling, absorbed in the dance, both arms held forward in a slow social-dance hold, the upper hand open at chest height and the lower hand open at waist height, both reaching toward the right side of the picture, the fingers relaxed and together, both feet flat in a small rise

back_dance.a.description: seen from behind at three quarters, turned away from the viewer toward the upper right corner of the picture: the back of his head and his back show, a sliver of cheek on the right, the face hidden, both arms held forward in a slow social-dance hold, the upper hand open at chest height and the lower hand open at waist height, both reaching toward the right side of the picture, the fingers relaxed and together, weight on one foot, the other heel lifted

back_dance.b.description: seen from behind at three quarters, turned away from the viewer toward the upper right corner of the picture: the back of his head and his back show, a sliver of cheek on the right, the face hidden, both arms held forward in a slow social-dance hold, the upper hand open at chest height and the lower hand open at waist height, both reaching toward the right side of the picture, the fingers relaxed and together, both feet flat in a small rise

back_dance.c.description: seen from behind at three quarters, turned away from the viewer toward the upper right corner of the picture: the back of his head and his back show, a sliver of cheek on the right, the face hidden, both arms held forward in a slow social-dance hold, the upper hand open at chest height and the lower hand open at waist height, both reaching toward the right side of the picture, the fingers relaxed and together, weight on the other foot, one heel lifted

back_dance.d.description: seen from behind at three quarters, turned away from the viewer toward the upper right corner of the picture: the back of his head and his back show, a sliver of cheek on the right, the face hidden, both arms held forward in a slow social-dance hold, the upper hand open at chest height and the lower hand open at waist height, both reaching toward the right side of the picture, the fingers relaxed and together, both feet flat in a small rise

sidestep.a.description: seen in a clean side profile walking toward the right side of the picture, the nose and both toes pointing right, one eye showing, taking a long easy step, the front heel just touching the floor and the back foot on its toes, arms swinging low at the sides, relaxed hands

sidestep.b.description: seen in a clean side profile walking toward the right side of the picture, the nose and both toes pointing right, one eye showing, mid-step, the weight over one straight leg and the other foot passing it, arms low at the sides, relaxed hands

sidestep.c.description: seen in a clean side profile walking toward the right side of the picture, the nose and both toes pointing right, one eye showing, taking a long easy step with the other foot in front, the front heel just touching the floor and the back foot on its toes, arms swinging low at the sides, relaxed hands

sidestep.d.description: seen in a clean side profile walking toward the right side of the picture, the nose and both toes pointing right, one eye showing, mid-step on the other leg, the weight over one straight leg and the other foot passing it, arms low at the sides, relaxed hands

glance.a.description: seen from behind, his back to the viewer, head turned to look back over his shoulder toward the right side of the picture so his face shows in profile with one eye, curious and interested, arms relaxed

glance.b.description: seen from behind, his back to the viewer, head turned a little further over his shoulder toward the right side of the picture so his face shows in profile with one eye, smiling and interested, arms relaxed

clap.a.description: facing the viewer, hands apart at chest height about to clap, palms facing each other, delighted

clap.b.description: facing the viewer, palms together clapping at chest height, knees softly bent, delighted

cheer.a.description: facing the viewer, cheering with both arms straight up above his head and open hands, a big smile

cheer.b.description: facing the viewer, cheering with both arms up above his head and open hands, one hip dropped, a big smile
